Definition: Beth-Gamul, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: Beth-Gamul means house of recompense, and Jeremiah names it once, in Jeremiah 48:23, among the towns of Moab that would feel God's judgment — Kiriathaim, Beth-gamul, Beth-meon, one after another. A small Moabite town east of the Jordan, remembered only in a list of places under sentence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name fits the sentence: recompense came to the house of recompense.
